deviations.description: Second stepwise walkthrough: /task -> /orchestrate N --research -> review report and plan -> /revise N -> /orchestrate N --implement -> /todo
deviations.reason: Executing the literal three-command sequence would fail: /orchestrate N --implement is admitted only when a plan artifact already exists, and /revise N on a plan-less (researched-only) task only updates the task description (Description Update path), it does not create a plan. An explicit /orchestrate N --plan step is required between the research round and /revise for the walkthrough to actually be executable, per orchestrate.md's Forced Phases admission rules and reviser-agent.md's Stage 2 mode table.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — inserted an explicit /orchestrate N --plan step between --research and /revise so the walkthrough is actually executable)*
